title: EzyNetherrack
description: Adds a simple recipe to minecraft, allowing you to bulk haunt gravel into netherrack.
body:
Are you tired of having to make constant trips to teh nether for netherrack? EzyNetherrack adds a single Create processing recipe designed for modpacks and automation‑heavy worlds.

Added Recipe
Haunting (Create):

Input: Gravel

Output: Netherrack (1x)

Compatibility
Create 0.5.1f (BTW I know it is old I will add a later version in future)

Fully server‑safe

Works in bulk haunting setups

Work in progress.

If anyone asks, no I will not port it to another platform. Fabric and NeoForge confuse me.

Check out the soruce code @ http://bit.ly/3RHwH99
